earlier_scan.note: Yalakalore is essentially unattested (unclassified, SW Amazonia); no description exists

sources.citation: Eberhard, David M. 2009. Mamainde Grammar: A Northern Nambikwara language and its cultural context. PhD diss., Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. Utrecht: LOT (LOT 236). Sec. 1.2 'The Nambikwara Language Family', pp. 21-31 (Yalakalore at pp. 24-26).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Yalakalore language structure at all: 'two other related groups which are mentioned briefly in the literature but of which we know very little.. /jalakalo-tu/ (also known as Yalakalore)' (p.24); 'the Alapmunte and the Yalakalore were distinct groups.. probably Northern Nambikwaran, and, like many other groups in this region, have become extinct, leaving not a single descendent' (p.25); listed under 'Of Unknown Intelligibility' (p.26). (The grammar's stress chapter, sec. 2.3.4, describes Mamainde only.)
